senses.gloss:
अच्छ 1. अ-च्छ, अस्, आ, अम् (not shaded or
covered, fr. अ + छ for छद् or छाया, rt. छद्),
pellucid, transparent, clear; (अस्), m. a crystal.
—अच्छोद (अच्छ-उद), अस्, आ, अम्, having clear
water; (आ), f., N. of a river; a covering or garment
of Viṣṇu (?); (अम्), n., N. of a lake in the Himālaya
formed by the river Acchodā.

अच्छ 2. अच्छ, अस्, m. (corruption of ऋक्ष),
a bear.
—अच्छ-भल्ल, अस्, m. a bear; (भल्ल
itself means ‘a bear.’)

अच्छ 3. अच्छ or usually अच्छ, rarely अच्छम्,
ind., Ved. to, towards (governing the accusative and
[]
rarely the locative). It is a kind of separable pre-
position or prefix to verbs and verbal derivatives, as in
the following.

अ-च्छाय, अस्, आ, अम्, without shadow, casting no
shadow.

अच्छ-इ, cl. 2. P. -एति, -तुम्, or अच्छा-गम्, cl.
1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to attain, go towards.

अच्छ-नक्ष्, cl. 1. P. A., Ved. -नक्षति, -ते,
-क्षितुम्, to go towards, approach.

अच्छ-नश्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -नशति, -शितुम्, to
come near.

अच्छ-नी, cl. 1. P., Ved. -नयति, -नेतुम्, to lead
towards or to.

अच्छ-नु, cl. 2. P., Ved. -नौति, -नवितुम् or
-नुवितुम्, to call out to, to cheer.

अच्छ-पत्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -पतति, -तितुम्, and
Caus. P. -पतयति, -यितुम्, to fly towards.
अच्छ-वद्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -वदति, -दितुम्, to salute.

अच्छा-वच्, cl. 2. P., Ved. -वक्ति, -क्तुम्, to invite.
—अच्छा-वाक, अस्, m. ‘the inviter’, title of a par-
ticular priest or Ṛtvij, one of the sixteen required to
perform the great sacrifices with the Soma juice.
—अच्छावाकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, referring to the Acchā-
vāka; containing the word अच्छावाक.

अच्छेत (˚छ-इत), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. approached,
attained.
अच्छोक्ति (˚छ-उक्˚), इस्, f., Ved. invitation.

अच्छिद्र अ-च्छिद्र, अस्, आ, अम् (free from clefts
or flaws), unbroken, uninterrupted, uninjured; (अम्),
n. unbroken or uninjured condition, an action free
from defect or flaw; (एण), ind. uninterruptedly, from
first to last.
—अच्छिद्र-काण्ड, अम्, n. title of a
chapter of the Taittirīya-Brāhmaṇa.
—अच्छिद्रोति
(˚द्र-ऊति), इस्, इस्, इ, affording perfect protection.
—अच्छिद्रोध्नी (˚र-ऊध्˚), f., Ved. (a cow) having
a faultless udder.

अ-च्छिद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, uncut, uncurtailed;
not fragile.

अ-च्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, uncut, uncurtailed, uninjured;
undivided, inseparable.
—अच्छिन्न-पत्त्र, अस्, आ,
अम् (of a bird, or, in the Vedas, of an altar shaped
like a bird), having the wings uncurtailed, uninjured;
having uninjured leaves.
—अच्छिन्न-पर्ण, अस्, ई,
अम्, having uninjured leaves.
आ-च्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, cut off.

अ-च्छेदिक or अ-च्छैदिक, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, not
fit or needing to be cut.

अ-च्छेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, improper or impossible to
be cut, indivisible.

अच्छुप्ता अ-च्छुप्ता, f. (not touched by sin),
N. of one of the sixteen Vidyādevīs of the Jainas.
अच्छोटन अच्छोटन, अम्, n. hunting.

आच्छद् 1. आ-च्छद् (-छद्), cl. 10. P. -च्छ-
दयति or -च्छादयति, -यितुम्, to cover, hide; to
clothe, to dress, put on clothes; to conceal.

2. आ-च्छद्, त्, f., Ved. a cover, covering; a sheath.
—आच्छद्-विधान, अम्, n., Ved. an arrangement
made for defence, a means of covering; or (अस्, आ, अम्),
one who has such means.
आ-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, concealed, clothed.
आ-च्छाद, अस्, m. cloth, clothes.
आ-च्छादक, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing, hiding.
आ-च्छादित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, clothed.
आ-च्छादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, covering, concealing.
1. आ-च्छाद्य, ind. having clothed or put on.
2. आ-च्छाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be covered or clothed.

आच्छाक आच्छाक, अस्, m., N. of the tree
Morinda Tinctoria; (better आच्छुक, q. v.)

आच्छिद् आ-च्छिद् (-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छि-
नत्ति, -च्छिन्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to tear or cut off; to cut or
break in pieces; to take out of; to draw off; remove;
to cut off, exclude; to snatch away, to tear from, to
rob; to disregard, not to take notice of.

आ-च्छिद्य, ind. cutting off; cutting, excluding, dis-
regarding; setting aside, in spite of, notwithstanding.
आ-च्छेद, अस्, m. cutting, cutting off, excision.
आ-च्छेदन, अम्, n. excision, cutting off, exclusion.

आच्छुक आच्छुक, अस्, m., N. of the plant
Morinda Tinctoria. See आक्षिक and आच्छाक.

आच्छुरित आ-च्छुरित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. छुर्
with आ), scratched; irritated; (अम्), n. making a
noise with the finger-nails by rubbing them on one
another; a horse-laugh.

आच्छुरितक, अम्, n. a scratch with a finger-nail;
a horse-laugh.

आच्छृद् आ-च्छृद् (-छृद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छृ-
णत्ति, -च्छृन्ते, -च्छर्दितुम्, to pour upon, to fill.

आच्छो आ-च्छो (-छो), cl. 4. P. -च्छ्यति,
-च्छातुम्, to skin, to flay.

आच्छोदन आ-च्छोदन, अम्, n. (rt. छुद् for
चुद् ?), hunting, the chase. See अच्छोटन, आक्षोदन.

अच्छोद्य (˚छ-उद्˚), ind. having spoken to,
(Pāṇ. I. 4, 69.)
